title: LostieLauncher
subtitle: Game launcher for Windows
description: Windows game launcher built specifically for EricLostie, the largest Spanish-speaking streamer and fangame developer. The application centralizes his entire fangame catalog into a single native client, letting his community discover, download, install, update and manage his games from a polished interface, backed by a self-hosted server on jagoba.dev and an automatic update system that ensures players always run the latest version available.
techWpf: Main UI framework for Windows desktop applications with declarative XAML
techMvvm: MVVM pattern implemented with CommunityToolkit.Mvvm 8.4.2 for reactive binding and commands
techSharpCompress: Extraction of downloaded files supporting multiple compression formats
techVelopack: Automatic update system with delta updates to minimize download size
infrastructureDesc: The entire launcher backend runs on a self-hosted VPS on jagoba.dev. The game catalog, notifications and installer are served from dedicated endpoints.
infraUpdatesDesc: Velopack feed with full + delta packages
cicdDesc: Automated pipeline with GitHub Actions: pushing a v*.*.* tag triggers a win-x64 self-contained build, executable signing with Certum certificate, packaging with vpk generating full + delta .nupkg, GitHub Release creation and SSH deployment to VPS.
featureLibrary: Game library downloadable from a self-hosted content server
featureDownloads: Resumable downloads with pause/resume and real-time progress bar
featureKeys: Key system for exclusive content access
featureMyGames: 'My Games' view with version tracking and playtime
featureNews: News feed and notifications on the home screen
featureThemes: 10 different visual themes inspired by Pokémon
featureLanguages: 8 languages: Español, English, Català, Euskera, Galego, Português, Valencià, Français
featureStartup: Option to launch on Windows startup (normal or minimized)
